column3: like (mountains) rising a thousand yojanas high
like the vigilant, that for us
like a friend of the afflicted
like a breaker of good rules
like the moon in the sky
as if having obtained great wealth
as if obstructed by limiting condition
here easily the desired, so long
though seen, free of ego, of the real and unreal
worshipped the Lord of sacrifice with horse sacrifices
(they) praised with true mantras and their signs
of such and others, of the unborn
to the self that is moved/ spoken
of the ruler and the ruled
with the speed of the revolving wheels of the Lord's chariot
the Lord's lordship over the governed
the Lord's doing, to be imagined
with desire not obstructed even by the Lord
by the will of the Lord
in the Lord, of unfathomable glory, modern fancy and speculation
of the will of the Lord
by the younger brother of Love (Pradyumna? slightly desirous)
with the glow of a slight smile
with the beauty of a slight smile
face adorned with a slight smile
with mouth with terrible tusks like plough-poles
with fierce bow, said so many words
running to the mother with uttered words
like a child with a mushroom
touched by the hand of the one of excellent fame
the deeds of the one of excellent fame
of those whose minds are on the one of excellent fame
by the talk of the one of excellent fame
to the foremost of the renowned
in the lotus feet of the one of excellent fame
by serving the lotus feet of the one of excellent fame, gained by the company of the penniless
the lotus-seat of the foot of the one of excellent fame
devoted to the one of excellent fame
approached the one of excellent fame with samadhi
Agastya in the upper jaw, in the lower jaw
in the upper jaw... in the lower jaw
led the Kosalas to heaven, thus
bringing of Aniruddha in the second half
Agastya in the upper jaw, in the lower jaw
rose up, cutting through the clouds
garland of high, red, shining nails
his heart struck by the moonlight of high, red, shining nails
having risen at the end of the night
rose up, with the hue of heated gold
to the one who has risen
causes of the creation, preservation and dissolution of this
without refuge on the path of birth
from one on the wrong path
flew up against the gods, weapons raised
by going up and going down in turn
with the sheath of the soul overflowing with devotion
of the one wishing to discharge the bodily impurity
as if with arms of long waves thrown up
as if with arms of long waves thrown up, cried out in distress
in the ocean, sleepless and wakeful
with magnanimous laughter, jasmine-like teeth, shining
shone with magnanimous laughter, teeth like jasmine, moon-like face
in the north the Lord after
by the declared speed of time
... Brahma and the gods' lords, their blessings shattered by time
in the form of a belch
with wild girdle, armlets, bracelets and others
shining with wild girdle, armlets, bracelets and others
struck by his wild feeling, pure charming laughter and bashful looks
this one lifts up the thorn of the earth, of fierce valour
slaying of Hiranyaksha in lifting the earth from the ocean
with joyful heart and tear-filled eyes
eager to meet their beloved by seeing Uddhava
with a mass of lightning-flashing clouds
face of the night with rising moon
rushing with raised weapons and arms
in the work of gardens, groves, pleasure-grounds, city and palaces
should dismiss if to be dismissed
puffed up with the eight powers
in the abode of the awakened heart-lotus whorl
with gleaming jewels, excellent gold ornaments
uprooting the chiefs of mountains, wind-hosts
by the opening and closing (of the eyes)
the best of the immortals being sung
in the form of a valley
investiture with the sacred thread and so on
cause of unrealness of the non-self ceased
to him whose cause of unrealness has ceased
seen at two lakh yojanas above
above and below in the Self
having realised the Self by the Self
whose fame has found a holy place
to the abode of mere perception
going near Ajigarta, bought the middle one
one of calm mind should give up
of him who has heard good stories
brought near to mount, O long-lived one
came, of divine sages and ancestors
took up the protector of earth
the force of the shower of dust ceased
ceased, delusion shaken off by knowledge
(they) wait on without gifts in hand
to the one worshipped by the world
